description: Defines a struct 'Unit' for representing measurements with support for various units such as centimeters, inches, millimeters, points, and pica. Provides conversion, parsing, comparison, and formatting functionalities related to measurement units within the MigraDoc Document Object Model.

classes.name: Unit
classes.description: Represents a measurement unit with value and type, supporting various conversions and comparisons.

methods.name: FromCentimeter
methods.description: Creates a Unit object with type set to centimeter given a double value.

methods.name: FromMillimeter
methods.description: Creates a Unit object with type set to millimeter given a double value.

methods.name: FromPoint
methods.description: Creates a Unit object with type set to point given a double value.

methods.name: FromInch
methods.description: Creates a Unit object with type set to inch given a double value.

methods.name: FromPica
methods.description: Creates a Unit object with type set to pica given a double value.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses a string to create a Unit object, interpreting suffixes for units.

methods.name: ConvertType
methods.description: Converts the Unit instance to a different specified UnitType.
